company_blurb: Aurora Freight is a Helsinki-based multimodal logistics carrier operating Nordic road, rail, and Baltic short-sea corridors. Across port hubs in Vuosaari and Turku, its teams coordinate container routing, customs compliance, fleet telemetry, and enterprise freight contracts for industrial shippers.

departments.culture: Engineering builds and maintains route optimization services, EDI integrations, and container telemetry pipelines. Developers favor concise RFCs, automated deployment checks, and blameless postmortems when port feeds lag. Cross-team reviews happen every Tuesday before scheduled platform releases.

Finance manages carrier settlement ledgers, fuel surcharge models, bunker hedging reconciliations, and monthly close cycles. The team values clean audit trails, punctual variance reports, and structured spreadsheet conventions, keeping calm even during compressed quarter-end board reporting.

Legal oversees cross-border customs compliance, maritime liability clauses, vendor MSAs, and transport safety regulations across Baltic and EU jurisdictions. Colleagues work methodically through clause redlines and regulatory checklists, prioritizing clear guidance that keeps cargo moving.

Sales manages industrial shipper accounts, seasonal lane tenders, and volume rate proposals across Nordic manufacturing corridors. Account executives and sales operations collaborate closely in CRM pipelines to align lane capacity with Engineering timelines and Finance margin targets.
